title: Lovable
description: Lovable publishes its brand colours in its official Brand Hub (linked from lovable.dev): light blue (#4e93ff), blue (#4b73ff), violet (#bbc1ff), bubblegum (#ffa6f9), pink (#ff0178), red (#f7101d), orange (#ff6d1b) and yellow (#ffa517), with neutrals black (#1b1b1b) and creme (#f7f4ed).
